title: Rating Standards by Level for Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts
content:
Customer ratings on Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts are measured, warned on and excluded under figures that depend on the shopper's level.

| Level | Ratings in the average (most recent, not excluded) | Ratings needed before the average is used | Warning threshold (an average below this) | Rating floor (an average below this after the cure period) | Warning cure period | Rating exclusions granted in a rolling 30 days | Days after the rating date to request an exclusion |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Shop-Only Shopper | 100 | 25 | 4.65 stars | 4.5 stars | 14 calendar days | 3 | 7 calendar days |
| Full-Service Shopper | 100 | 25 | 4.7 stars | 4.6 stars | 14 calendar days | 3 | 7 calendar days |
| Full-Service Shopper Silver | 100 | 25 | 4.7 stars | 4.6 stars | 14 calendar days | 4 | 7 calendar days |
| Full-Service Shopper Gold | 100 | 25 | 4.7 stars | 4.6 stars | 21 calendar days | 5 | 10 calendar days |
| Full-Service Shopper Platinum | 100 | 25 | 4.7 stars | 4.6 stars | 21 calendar days | 6 | 10 calendar days |
| Full-Service Shopper Diamond | 100 | 25 | 4.7 stars | 4.6 stars | 30 calendar days | 8 | 14 calendar days |

**Reasons for which a low rating (1 to 3 stars) can be removed from the average** — the same four at every level: out-of-stock items, customer unreachable, store delay and app outage.

## What each figure means

- **Ratings in the average**: the number of most recent customer ratings, not counting excluded ones, that make up the rating average.
- **Ratings needed**: until the account has this many ratings, the average is not used for warnings, deactivation or level evaluation.
- **Warning threshold**: an average below this figure issues a rating warning.
- **Rating floor**: an average below this figure once the warning cure period has run leads to deactivation.
- **Warning cure period**: the calendar days after a rating warning during which the shopper can raise the average before deactivation is considered.
- **Exclusions in a rolling 30 days** and **days to request**: how many exclusions the shopper can receive in any rolling 30 days, and how many calendar days after the rating date an exclusion can be requested.

## Side by side (hypothetical averages)

| Hypothetical average | Shop-Only Shopper | Any Full-Service level |
|---|---|---|
| 4.68 | At or above 4.65: no warning | Below 4.7: warning threshold crossed |
| 4.55 | Below 4.65, not below 4.5 | Below 4.6: under the floor |
| 4.49 | Below 4.5: under the floor | Below 4.6: under the floor |
